answer: Locks are logged in sonnet, expire in whisper, and crystal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 192 aliases as a result needs 43 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 80 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
